sonnet.problem: Most choice cards are pure discovery questions with no context that lets a baker reason to the answer. Card 4 (vineyard vs olive grove vs wheat field), card 8 (walk backward), card 9 (Canaan, when the baker would naturally guess Ham), card 12 (expand territory) and card 14 (350 years) can only be answered by luck. Together they outnumber the informed guesses, so the stop leans on luck.
sonnet.rule: A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.
